title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Grug?
description:
Seven real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Grug from The Croods, through a dictator, two presidents, the King of Rock and a movie star.

Adolf Hitler → Francisco Franco → Dwight D. Eisenhower → Richard Nixon → Elvis Presley → Lisa Marie Presley → Nicolas Cage → Grug

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
